summary: Created a self-signed root CA named "OS Comparison Root CA" on node1 (RSA 4096, 10-year validity, CN=OS Comparison Root CA) and installed it into the system trust store via update-ca-certificates. Verified trust with a freshly issued leaf certificate that openssl verified using only the default system CA bundle (no -CAfile). Then performed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id and CA trust state, issued a native reboot whose acknowledgement returned before disconnect, polled until the node was reachable again, confirmed boot_id changed (proving an actual restart), and re-verified the CA files and trust functionality post-reboot with a second independent leaf-cert verification.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS (Ubuntu 16.04 Xenial) and confirmed openssl/update-ca-certificates availability
Generated 4096-bit RSA key and self-signed x509 root CA cert with CN=OS Comparison Root CA, 3650-day validity
Copied CA cert to /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt and ran update-ca-certificates (1 added)
Verified CA presence via hash-symlinks in /etc/ssl/certs
Issued a test leaf certificate signed by the new CA and confirmed system-wide trust via 'openssl verify' with no -CAfile
Cleaned up leaf test artifacts, retained CA key/cert
Captured pre-restart baseline: boot_id and CA file/symlink presence
Triggered native reboot (shutdown -r now, backgrounded) with acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again
Confirmed boot_id changed, proving genuine restart
Verified CA files persisted post-reboot and re-tested trust with a second independently issued leaf certificate verified successfully

evidence.requirement: Create local CA named 'OS Comparison Root CA' on node1

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity + CA trust state) for node1
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 8336c3a1-91fc-4135-b26a-5d2863cb2594 and confirmed CA file/symlink present before restart
shutdown -r now issued in background; REBOOT_ACK returned before disconnect

evidence.requirement: Proof node1 actually restarted (changed boot identity)
evidence.summary: Node briefly unreachable (connection refused), then reachable again with new boot_id 27295f5e-6524-41e2-8111-417b9416d3f9, differing from baseline

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of CA trust and data on node1
evidence.summary: Confirmed CA cert file, symlink, and key material intact post-reboot; issued and verified a new leaf certificate against the default system trust store, confirming the CA remains trusted after restart
